Per coin: 5m-chart buy/sell momentum %, buying-zone low, paper limit trigger 1.5-6% below price. Paper-buy only after price dips to trigger then ticks up 1%+. Best score (1h% x buy%) fills free slots first. Watch expires 40 min. DIP ENTRY v9 (owner voice notes 1:59 and 2:14 AM IST 7 Oct): a coin is bought only when its price is 10% to 30% below its SIGNAL price (the price when first seen), not below its high. If it falls past -30% it is skipped. Liquidity must be known and at least $5,000 at the moment of buying (unknown liquidity is tracked, but never bought). Rug = liquidity under $3,000. Dip zone numbers -10..-30 are agent-chosen from the owner order to use options 2 and 3, thresholds 3k and 5k are from the owner voice note. Fills UNVERIFIED.

Owner rules 12:32 PM + 4:26 PM, restored 7:57 PM.
rules.rug: liquidity < $3,000 = full loss (only early exit; owner 1:59 AM IST 7 Oct)
